The Subtask Name: EC Number Extraction  
Step Range: 0-5  
The Oracle: EC Number Extraction  
Evidence: Extract EC numbers from the identified chemicals in the paper.  
Loop Info:  
  is_loop_related: false  
  loop_role: none  
  loop_group_id: null  
  reversibility: irreversible  
  loop_risk_score: 0.0  

Step 0: Identify the relevant paper on ScienceDirect.  
Step 1: Access the paper discussing SPFMV and SPCSV in the Pearl Of Africa from 2016.  
Step 2: Locate the section detailing the virus testing method.  
Step 3: Extract the EC numbers of the two most commonly used chemicals.  
Step 4: Verify the EC numbers are listed in the correct format.  
Step 5: Alphabetize the EC numbers and format them as required.
